metadata.dcterms:title: arXiv:math/0110009v3 [math.MG] 3 Sep 2003
metadata.dcterms:creator: Cohn, By Henry
Elkies*, Noam
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We develop an analogue for sphere packing of the linear programming bounds for error-correcting codes, and use it to prove upper bounds for the density of sphere packings, which are the best bounds known at least for di- mensions 4 through 36. We conjecture that our approach can be used to solve the sphere packing problem in dimensions 8 and 24.
